sentences.text: Alexornis was reclassified as a member of the Enantiornithes after other fossils clarified its anatomy.

Alexornis lived during the Late Cretaceous in the La Bocana Roja Formation of Baja California, Mexico, where the formation dates to the Campanian stage approximately 73 million years ago, though the fossil record for the genus spans from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
The fossil record for Alexornis spans from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
